Structured data format with labeled fields ("Event:", "Outcome:") establishes a pattern of concise factual entries, suggesting the model tracks this as a complete record.

"Record completed." is a closing delimiter phrase mirroring the opening "Record initiated," signaling the end of the task block; next tokens likely continue with a new instruction, summary, or acknowledgment.
"Event: A man fell into a pit. Outcome: He was rescued. Record completed." — the final sentence "Record completed." serves as a terminal marker, so the next token likely closes the interaction or begins a new prompt section.
"Training snippet provided. Record completed." — short, formulaic closing phrase.</explanation>
